requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate have not yet dispersed."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Before the words had even left his mouth, 万俟(mòqí)靖 came racing up from the foot of the mountain."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "万俟靖背着昏迷的女子冲进大殿,腰间的铁牌刻着:仇(qiú)霜。"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Give her one Huiling Pill and she'll be fine."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Senior Sister 曾, Elder 覃 wants you at the barrier over there. Senior Brother 万俟 and I will handle things here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Alright. If Miss 仇 wakes up, come get me right away."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "万俟靖 scratched his head, then turned and ran toward the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jie Xuan stood at the hall entrance, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin, it's been a long time. I come on the order of the Pavilion Master to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three parts? The spirit stones were saved up by the sect through hard work. When did outsiders get to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The barrier has cracked. Leaving the spirit stones in your hands isn't safe. I'll come back in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "解玄 sneered coldly, turned and walked away without looking back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "He said three days, and he always keeps his word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Lechuan can look after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared."}, {"id": 1, "text": "At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the formation-eye token. Guard it, and you will have guarded your Dao."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Le Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain gate, 万俟靖 handed over a straw raincoat."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Brother 万俟. Miss 仇 has woken up, so please pass on my thanks to her."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Good that you're awake. You've been out for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked out at the cracked sky beyond the window."}, {"id": 1, "text": "No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Jie Xuan's seal."}]}

translations.1: Early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate have not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister 曾, Elder 覃 wants you at the barrier over there. Senior Brother 万俟 and I will handle things here.
translations.11: Alright. If Miss 仇 wakes up, come get me right away.
translations.12: 万俟靖 scratched his head, then turned and ran toward the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Jie Xuan stood at the hall entrance, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, it's been a long time. I come on the order of the Pavilion Master to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Three parts? The spirit stones were saved up by the sect through hard work. When did outsiders get to take them?
translations.16: The barrier has cracked. Leaving the spirit stones in your hands isn't safe. I'll come back in three days.
translations.17: 解玄 sneered coldly, turned and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: He said three days, and he always keeps his word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Lechuan can look after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared.
translations.21: At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the formation-eye token. Guard it, and you will have guarded your Dao.
translations.23: Le Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, 万俟靖 handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother 万俟. Miss 仇 has woken up, so please pass on my thanks to her.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Good that you're awake. You've been out for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and looked out at the cracked sky beyond the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Jie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before the words had even left his mouth, 万俟(mòqí)靖 came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Gasping for breath, he said that a young woman was lying by the road at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Bring her up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing pills.
translations.8: 万俟靖背着昏迷的女子冲进大殿,腰间的铁牌刻着:仇(qiú)霜。
translations.9: It's not serious, she's just run out of spiritual energy. Give her one Huiling Pill and she'll be fine.
